uncertain.what: Slag tee: dot on dry ground beside the shelter; a long tee strip 20-25 yds left may be hole 6's back tee or hole 3's; not moved
Gold tee at along 12 sits between two pads (6 yds short of the upper pad); kept

slag vs standing water: both are black in RGB and NIR; ponds marked by OSM were kept as water, unmapped dark areas were drawn as slag (sand). Parts of 8 right, 9 left heart, 10 left blobs and 18 right could be water

native: the dryland beyond the irrigation line is tan in June 2021 and Nov 2023 with the same edge; it is drawn 10-15 yds beyond the package fairway (which already includes the irrigated rough). Whether it is mown dry rough or unmown native is not certain at 0.6 m
no lidar (3DEP has no coverage here; only the Meta canopy model): tree edges from the photo / CIR only
greens are not in OSM (green = hole-line end point); write_layers has no green lie, so greens and green-side slag bunkers outside the 120-400 window were not drawn
